answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks sybil farming. To claim a work slot, an agent burns a $30 deposit; the slot opens after verified work, and idle or fraudulent slots forfeit it. A whisper is not enough: 1,000 fake identities must burn $30,000 to wander into the pool, while the epoch pool pays only $3,000. An honest agent pays one $30 deposit, keeps its full share, and earns the fee back with work done. That is no fable: every slot costs real money.
